show.name: The Big Money Show
show.summary: Taylor Riggs, Brian Brenberg and Jackie DeAngelis host an informative and fast-paced hour filled with business topics that impact everyone from Wall Street to the average person.

show.name: 5 News at 5
show.summary: National and international news.

show.name: Access Daily with Mario & Kit
show.summary: The latest celebrity gossip, opinions, Hollywood happenings, and the day's big news.

show.name: Inside Politics
show.summary: Dana Bash features the top political stories, sourced by the best reporters.

show.name: Outnumbered
show.summary: Featuring an ensemble of four female panelists and one rotating male, Outnumbered examines the top news stories as well as the leading pop culture and relationship issues dominating the headlines. FNC's Harris Faulkner, Kayleigh McEnany and Emily Compagno lead the program's coverage, while alternating co-panelists weigh in with analysis.

show.name: Newsline
show.summary: Bianca de la Garza tackles the big news from D.C., N.Y., across America, and around the world!

show.name: Mr. Osomatsu
show.summary: The majority of the Matsuno household is comprised of six identical siblings: self-centered leader Osomatsu, manly Karamatsu, voice of reason Choromatsu, cynical Ichimatsu, hyperactive Juushimatsu, and lovable Todomatsu. Despite each one of them being over the age of 20, they are incredibly lazy and have absolutely no motivation to get a job, choosing to live as NEETs instead. In the rare occurrence that they try to look for employment and are somehow able to land an interview, their unique personalities generally lead to their swift rejection. From trying to pick up girlfriends to finding the perfect job, the daily activities of the Matsuno brothers are never dull as they go on all sorts of crazy, and often downright bizarre, adventures. Though they desperately search for a way to improve their social standing, it won't be possible if they can't survive the various challenges that come with being sextuplets!

show.name: The Young and the Restless
show.summary: The Young and the Restless revolves around the rivalries, romances, hopes and fears of the residents of the fictional Midwestern metropolis, Genoa City. The lives and loves of a wide variety of characters mingle through the generations, dominated by the Newman, Abbott, Chancellor, Baldwin and Winters families. ­ When The Young and the Restless premiered in 1973, it revolutionized the daytime drama. It continues to set the standard with strong characters, socially conscious storylines, romance and sensuality.

show.name: Love Sea ～愛の居場所～
show.summary: Popular romance novelist Rakumoto Ai is sent to a remote island to write. There, he meets cheerful tour guide Muto Kaishin. Though their personalities clash, the island's charm slowly softens their hearts, leading them to discover a quiet, healing love.

show.name: ABC News Live
show.summary: ABC News Live will bring streaming viewers the latest headlines, compelling stories, interviews and roundtable discussions.

show.name: Aftenshowet
show.summary: DR1's journalistic talk show directly from the City Hall Square in Copenhagen.

show.name: America Reports
show.summary: A look at the latest news and headlines with Sandra Smith and John Roberts

show.name: CNN News Central (PM)
show.summary: News from around the world with Brianna Keilar and Boris Sanchez.

show.name: Alles was zählt
show.summary: Alles was zählt is a German television soap opera. The original plot revolved around Diana Sommer's dream to become a world class ice skater. She fell in love with Julian Herzog, who signed her at the prestigious Steinkamp Sport and Wellness Center, run by the unscrupulous Steinkamp dynasty. The story continues to revolve around the Steinkamp Sport and Wellness Centre and its quest to become a sporting powerhouse, as well as the lives of the characters who work at and around the Centre.

show.name: 5 News at 18.55
show.summary: National and international news.

show.name: American Agenda
show.summary: American Agenda with hosts Bob Brooks & Katrina Szish is a live, fast-paced look at national news and international events. The program brings viewers the latest from Washington, with insightful analysis from lawmakers and experts, and media reports from New York and around the globe.

show.name: Katy Tur Reports
show.summary: The latest breaking news, reporting and live coverage of the day's important stories; hosted by trusted NBC News journalists, these dynamic hours offer discussions with newsmakers, journalists and politicians.

show.name: Beyond the Gates
show.summary: Beyond the Gates is set in a leafy Maryland suburb just outside of Washington D.C., and in one the most affluent African American counties in the United States. Here you'll find a posh gated community with winding tree-lined streets and luxurious mansions to call home. At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. But behind these pristine walls and lush, manicured gardens are juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered. And those that live outside these gates are watching closely. These are the places where our characters live, love, work and play. Those who have "made it" and those who haven't are all trying to navigate life … and some with more grace than others.

show.name: Making Money with Charles Payne
show.summary: Long-time Wall Street broker and analyst Charles Payne hosts his own daily program Making Money with Charles Payne that helps viewers spot emerging investment prospects. A panel of business and market specialists joins him to discuss the latest headlines, wrap up the day's activities in the markets, and focus on tomorrow's moneymakers. Payne says, "There are money-making opportunities behind every headline." His goal is to help viewers "find their confidence in the markets and realize their long-term dreams and goals."

show.name: General Hospital
show.summary: General Hospital, which celebrated its golden anniversary on April 1, 2013, continues its tradition of passion, intrigue and adventure that takes place in the fictional town of Port Charles in upstate New York. The glamour and excitement of those who have come to find their destinies in this familiar seaport town intertwine with the lives, loves and fortunes of beloved, well-known faces. As always, love, danger and mind blowing plot twists continue to abound on General Hospital with contemporary storylines and unforgettable characters.

show.name: 5 News at 19:55
show.summary: National and international news

show.name: The Claman Countdown
show.summary: The close of the trading day is covered.

show.name: The Story
show.summary: The Story with Martha MacCallum, anchored by Martha MacCallum, focuses on the stories that are most important to Americans with insight from top newsmakers and analysts.

name: Episode 21
summary: The team repair a giant plush hound dog with rock star pedigree, a Cypriot shepherd's bag and a prizewinning sewing machine from the 1980s.

show.name: The Repair Shop
show.summary:
The Repair Shop is a workshop of dreams, where broken or damaged cherished family heirlooms are brought back to life.

Furniture restorers, horologists, metal workers, ceramicists, upholsterers and all manner of skilled craftsmen and women have been brought together to work in one extraordinary space, restoring much-loved possessions to their former glory.

Many of these items have incredible stories behind them and a unique place in history: from an accordion played in the Blitz by a woman who is now in her 90s, to a beautifully crafted clock made by a father who was completely blind; a Pinball machine that is currently being used as a kitchen counter, and a Davenport desk with its trademark fake drawers which fooled burglars - and their crowbar.

The Repair Shop is an antidote to our throwaway culture and shines a light on the wonderful treasures to be found in homes across the country.

name: Episode 2
summary: Denise Van Outen meets the Osbournes, a farming family from the Midlands who rely on convenience to keep life running smoothly. So how will they get along when they swap their luxury supermarket for a week of shopping at one of the largest discount stores in the UK? From food and drink to cleaning products and pet supplies, they put it all to the test - and end the week by hosting a children's party. Then comes the big reveal, where they find out how much they have actually saved.

show.name: The Big Pound Shop Swap
show.summary: Could you live off bargain store products alone? Denise Van Outen leads this bold consumer experiment, as proudly picky families swap their supermarket go-tos for discount store alternatives.

show.name: Pompeii: Life in the City
show.summary:
Pompeii is the world's most incredibly preserved Roman city. Now historians Dan Snow and Doctor Kate Lister take us into this extraordinary time capsule, to reveal what it would really have been like to live there.

They discover everything from exactly what people ate, to where they slept (and who they slept with), what jobs they did and how dangerous the city was at night. This is real life in Pompeii in all its gritty, glorious detail.

show.name: Deadline: White House
show.summary: Hosted by Nicolle Wallace, this program provides in-depth reporting and dynamic discussions on the political stories driving the news cycle. Nicolle Wallace brings viewers the latest political developments of the day, in addition to interviews with leading newsmakers and influential politicians. Drawing on her years of experience as communications chief for President George W. Bush and senior advisor for the McCain-Palin campaign, Wallace provides political insight and clarity on where key decision-makers stand on complex issues.

show.name: Kudlow
show.summary: Host Larry Kudlow leads roundtable discussions on the policies impacting the domestic and global economies and interviews with business influencers across the world.

show.name: ABC News Breakfast
show.summary: Be the first to know what's happened overnight. Michael Rowland and Lisa Millar, Paul Kennedy, Georgie Tunny and Nate Byrne bring you breaking news, interviews and all the information you need to get you through the day.

show.name: Al Rojo Vivo
show.summary: Al Rojo Vivo is a news magazine that in one hour, takes viewers on a journey through the world. It is an "information paella" that offers something for everyone: local and international news, entertainment, fashion, live interviews, special investigations, human interest, health, consumer alerts and new technology.

show.name: The Arena with Kasie Hunt
show.summary: Kasie Hunt brings key players into the arena for sharp analysis and panel discussion on the latest news in politics and culture.

name: Episode 6
summary:
It's Children's Week, and for the first time ever, the show introduces elements of adaptive fashion.

The sewers tackle a pattern for children's dungarees, with adaptive fashion designer Victoria Jenkins joining the judges to help assess their efforts.

In the Transformation Challenge, sustainability is key as the sewers repurpose maternity wear into toddler outfits, giving new life to old garments.

Finally, the Sewing Bee welcomes mini models for the Made to Measure challenge. The sewers are tasked with creating outfits inspired by what their models want to be when they grow up, ranging from polar explorer to beekeeper to politician.

The results are unexpected, and a perfect fit could secure a place in next week's competition.

Who will handle it like child's play, and who will be sent to the naughty step?

show.name: The Great British Sewing Bee
show.summary: Amateur sewers take on challenges as they compete to be named Britain's best home sewer.

name: Episode 7
summary: Johnny attempts to salvage parts from a classic RAF plane to make into furniture. Plus, Johnny and Bev visit an old cinema packed full of antiques.

show.name: Johnny Vegas' Little Shop of Antiques
Johnny Vegas' Little Shop of Antiques
show.summary: Actor and comedian Johnny Vegas embarks on a new adventure: opening an antiques shop in Lancashire. Can he turn his ramshackle dream into a business?

show.name: The Will Cain Show
show.summary: Featuring conversations with newsmakers from across politics, business, culture and sports, The Will Cain Show will offer a comprehensive look at the news of the day in a signature podcast style.

show.name: The Chris Salcedo Show
show.summary: "The Chris Salcedo Show" features your conservative, liberty-loving host, who confronts the biased press, both political parties, and the extremist left — every day.

name: Episode 6
summary: It's the morning after the night before for Louis, as he comes clean to Liv about what happened on his date. Christine meets with Anna and Paul to discuss her future at the agency.

show.name: Celebs Go Dating
show.summary: Single celebrities join an exclusive dating agency in a bid to find true love. Matchmakers pair them with non-celebrity partners and the cameras capture every romantic and cringe-filled moment.

name: Sarah Henshaw
summary: A night at a concert turns tragic when a woman is attacked and killed by her boyfriend.

show.name: Last Night Out
show.summary:
Last Night Out reveals the chilling stories of the final night of fun for those whose evenings end in tragedy. We meet the under 35s who go out to have a good time but a terrible turn in events leads to their murders.

This UK series uses intimate, down-the-lens interviews with family members, friends, and key figures from the investigation team to tell the stories of these tragic deaths. Blending CCTV footage, social media posts and home movies, each episode forensically pieces together the narrative of their last night out.

show.name: The Evening Edit
show.summary: Host Elizabeth MacDonald interviews industry experts to get the inside scoop on the day's leading headlines as they relate to your wallet.

show.name: The Lead with Jake Tapper
show.summary: CNN's chief Washington correspondent, Jake Tapper, hosts this hourlong weekday afternoon program, which mixes Tapper's interests with headlines from around the country and the world, headlines that span politics, money, sports and popular culture. The Lead with Jake Tapper also concentrates on bringing stories that aren't found on front pages -- buried leads -- to the forefront. Tapper came to CNN from ABC News, where he most recently served as senior White House correspondent.

show.name: The Five
show.summary: The Five is an American news and talk show on Fox News Channel featuring a rotating panel who discuss current stories, political issues, and pop culture. The show premiered in July 2011, replacing the Glenn Beck program, and airs on weekdays at 5:00 p.m. ET with replays at 4:00 a.m. ET. On October 3, 2011, after successful ratings and high popularity, Fox News announced that The Five would become the permanent 5 p.m. series, as the program had previously been announced to last only during the summer. The Five is currently the second-most-watched program in all of cable news in the United States, placing only behind The O'Reilly Factor, also on the Fox News Channel. The program has occasionally been the number one rated cable news series in the key 25 to 54 viewing demographic.

show.name: Carl Higbie Frontline
show.summary: Carl Higbie Frontline focuses on providing commonsense news analysis, exposing big government overreach and the media's shortfalls — all while always fighting for American values. Produced from Newsmax's Manhattan studios covering breaking news and exploring key issues such as personal liberty, security, and government transparency.

show.name: Prominent getrennt - Die Villa der Verflossenen
Prominent getrennt - Die Villa der Verflossenen
The Beat with Ari Melber
show.summary: The Beat with Ari Melber delivers the biggest political and news stories of the day, with interviews and original reporting from around the nation. An Emmy-winning journalist, attorney and former Senate staffer, Melber cuts through the spin and the noise to tell you what's really happening. Real news, every night.

show.name: The Bottom Line
show.summary: Dagen McDowell and Sean Duffy take on the hotly debated issues in the business and political world, plus the kitchen table topics that matter most to Americans.

show.name: Special Report
show.summary: Special Report with Bret Baier (formerly Special Report with Brit Hume) is an American television news and political commentary program appearing on Fox News Channel, currently hosted by Bret Baier. It airs live each Monday through Friday at 6:00 PM ET. The show focuses on both reporting and analysis of the day's events, with a primary focus on national political news. The show has been a part of the Fox News program lineup since 1998 and is the number one cable news broadcast in its time slot.

show.name: The Record with Greta Van Susteren
The Record with Greta Van Susteren
show.summary: Award-winning journalist Greta Van Susteren digs into the top stories of the day with the focus on why they matter to the American people. Greta speaks with the top newsmakers on both sides of the aisle, creating a conversation and dialogue that is imperative for the nation's well-being.

show.name: The Weeknight
show.summary: One-on-one conversations with politicians and newsmakers, and the breaking issues of the day.

show.name: ABC News Mornings
show.summary: When big stories break, turn to ABC News in the mornings to bring you what's happening and why it matters. We have more reporters in more places, serving and connecting communities and telling your stories. Presented by Gemma Veness (Mon-Wed) and Dan Bourchier (Thu-Fri).

show.name: Erin Burnett OutFront
show.summary: Erin Burnett OutFront is an hour-long television news program hosted by Erin Burnett on CNN. The show premiered on October 3, 2011 in the 7PM and 11PM time slot to replace John King, USA. CNN said in 2011 they hoped Burnett's expected popularity would provide an "attractive" opening to an evening of "talk shows and news analysis". Erin Burnett, OutFront is broadcast live from CNN's Time Warner Center studios in New York City or on location from the site of a breaking news event, airing from 7:00 pm ET to 8:00 pm ET and also airs via tape-delay on CNN Philippines every Tuesday-Friday at 5:00 pm local time since March 17, 2015. The program covers a number of news stories of the day in a Count-up format, starting at #1 – most important and making it to #7 by the end of the hour. Burnett's program features taped packages from CNN Correspondents along with analysis and panel discussion.

show.name: The Ingraham Angle
show.summary: The Ingraham Angle cuts through the Washington chatter to speak directly with unexpected voices and the actual people who are impacted by the news of the day.

show.name: Rob Schmitt Tonight
show.summary: Rob Schmitt Tonight locks in all the late-breaking stories that matter to you, and delivers the up-to-the-minute news you need to hear before turning in.

name: Metamorphosis
summary: The team returns home with unexpected cargo; an unsettling experiment occurs, and a new talent is discovered.

show.name: Alien: Earth
show.summary: When a mysterious space vessel crash-lands on Earth, a young woman and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat. As members of the crash recovery crew search for survivors among the wreckage of a mysterious crashed space vessel, they encounter mysterious predatory life forms more terrifying than they could have ever imagined. With this new threat unlocked, the search crew must fight for survival and what they choose to do with this discovery could change planet Earth as they know it.

show.name: WWE NXT
show.summary: Each Wednesday at 8:00 p.m. ET, WWE Superstars and Divas of tomorrow face off on WWE NXT, a one-hour weekly show that features the brightest and best of WWE's rising stars. WWE NXT showcases the Superstars and Divas from WWE's Performance Center as well as appearances from WWE Superstars and Legends in an intimate setting. WWE NXT broadcasts from the state-of-the-art Full Sail LIVE venue on the Full Sail University in campus in Orlando, Florida.

previousepisode.name: Main Event: Tatum Paxley vs. Sol Ruca (c) for the NXT Women's North American Championship

show.name: The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch
show.summary: Gaining full and unprecedented access to one of the most infamous and secretive hotspots of paranormal and UFO-related activities on earth, The Secret of Skinwalker Ranch will feature a team of scientists and experts who will conduct a thorough search of this infamous 512-acre property located in Utah's Uinta Basin. They will attempt to find out the truth behind more than 200 years of mysteries - involving everything from UFO sightings and paranormal activities to animal mutilations and Native American legends of a shape-shifting creature known simply as The Skinwalker.

name: You're My Favorite Kicker!
summary: Jimmy, a saxophone-playing real estate agent, Erica, who raises rare chickens and a mother-son duo, Stephanie and Cameron, are among 100 contestants competing.

show.name: The 1% Club
show.summary: The 1% Club is a unique, compelling and funny entertainment show that tests the nation's intelligence, based on a scientific survey. It's a chance to test how your brain works through a series of questions that all have a right answer but can also lead to a series of entertaining wrong answers along the way. Whether you're a contestant vying for the cash prize or a viewer playing with your friends and family on the app, answer enough questions correctly, and you could earn yourself a place in the 1% Club: an elite group of people who can honestly say they've outwitted 99% of the population.

show.name: Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta
show.summary: The city's hip hop elite are about to have their lives changed in ways they never imagined - for better or for worse! In the music mecca of the South, artists rise and fall, families grow and are torn apart, and what goes around - definitely comes around. These players continue to be on the cutting edge of the good, bad and naughty side of love. Returning fan favorites will be joined by some new faces on Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta.

show.name: All In with Chris Hayes
show.summary: On All In with Chris Hayes, Chris Hayes delivers impactful stories that don't always make the front page. Drawing from his background as a reporter, Hayes goes on the road to uncover the truth by knocking on doors, digging deeper and speaking with people representing all points of view.

name: Quarterfinals 1
summary: Eleven acts take the stage and a Live Show Golden Buzzer will send one act directly to the finals. America can vote for their three favorite acts to advance to the semi-finals by using the "AGT" App or going to NBC.com.

show.name: America's Got Talent
show.summary: With the talent search open to acts of all ages, America's Got Talent has brought the variety format back to the forefront of American culture by showcasing performers from across the country. The series is a true celebration of the American spirit, featuring a colorful array of singers, dancers, comedians, contortionists, impressionists, jugglers, magicians, ventriloquists and hopeful stars, all vying for their chance to win America's hearts and the $1 million prize.

show.name: Anderson Cooper 360°
show.summary: Anderson Cooper 360° (commonly shortened to either AC-360 or 360) is a television news show on CNN, hosted by the American journalist Anderson Cooper. show.name: Hannity
show.summary:
Hannity & Colmes was a live television show on Fox News Channel in the United States, hosted by Sean Hannity and Alan Colmes, who respectively presented a conservative and liberal perspective. The series premiered on October 7, 1996, and the final episode aired on January 9, 2009. It was the precursor to the Hannity program, which airs in the same time slot. The show offered Hannity's conservative views and Colmes's liberal views incorporated into a current news story, or in conjunction with a featured guest.

In addition to politics, the show featured debate about soft news stories, such as the 2006 Duke University lacrosse team scandal or the death of Anna Nicole Smith, or one-on-one interviews with politicians, commonly with the host who most closely shared the guest's political ideology. The show's format resembled a former CNN show called Crossfire, which similarly had co-hosts on both the left and right.

Fox announced on November 24, 2008 that Alan Colmes would leave the show at the end of the year, but he remains a commentator on Fox News, runs the blog Liberaland, and makes occasional appearances on other programs like The O'Reilly Factor, and Shovio.com's TalkBackTV. On December 11, it was announced that Hannity would take over the time slot alone with a new show simply titled Hannity, which would have a format closer to his weekend program Hannity's America. January 9, 2009 was the last airing of Hannity & Colmes, with January 12 marking the beginning of the new Hannity program.

With the support of his in-laws, who run sales and marketing for the business, Joe is on the brink of breaking through the fiercely competitive marketplace to establish an American auto brand in a category all its own.  

From a high-water emergency response vehicle built for fire departments to traverse downed palm trees to a ‘Boat Truck' – an amphibious Jeep that cruises the highway and dives straight into the water Truck Dynasty showcases next-level creations built to conquer land, water, and everything in between.

Aras's wife, Banu, tragically passed away due to certain complications during their daughter's birth. After her death, although Aras refrained from pursuing a new relationship for some time, he eventually became engaged to Pelin—a woman from a similarly prominent family and now a management executive at the hospital—to provide Derin with a stable family life.

When fate reveals the heart-wrenching truth that Mahinur and Aras's daughters, Bade and Derin, were switched at birth, a devoted mother and a businessman find their worlds colliding in unimaginable ways. Bound by the desperate need to save the life of Bade, who was diagnosed with hemolytic anaemia, they enter into a marriage of convenience to bring a sibling into the world, who can become a stem cell donor. Yet, as they navigate the delicate threads of secrets, sacrifices, and a carefully crafted facade, an unexpected love begins to blossom—turning their unlikely union into a tale of redemption, healing, and the power of the heartstrings.

show.name: Wake Up America
show.summary: Start your day and weekend with real news and analysis from Rob Finnerty, Michael Grimm & Sarah Williamson and team.

show.name: Smilla's Sense of Snow
show.summary: Smilla's Sense of Snow centers around Smilla Jaspersen, a Greenlandic woman living in Copenhagen, who investigates the suspicious death of a young Inuit boy, Isaiah, who falls from a rooftop. Smilla's unique "sense of snow" and knowledge of Greenland lead her to uncover a conspiracy involving scientific research and a cover-up.

show.name: Clevatess: Majuu no Ou to Akago to Shikabane no Yuusha
Clevatess: Majuu no Ou to Akago to Shikabane no Yuusha
show.summary: One of the Lords of Dark Beasts, Clevatess's reign shatters when he revives a hero he personally slayed and adopts an orphaned humanoid baby—the last hope to save a dying world. Now bound together, what fate awaits this unlikely trio?

show.name: Catch Your Luck
show.summary: A drama depicting the turbulent and eventful growth period of three friends; one rich, one poor, and one who wants to be rich, and their families.

show.name: Countdown
show.summary: Countdown begins with a suspicious murder in broad daylight, leading Los Angeles Police Department officer Mark Meachum to be recruited to a secret task force of undercover agents from all branches of law enforcement that will investigate the death. But as the truth of a more sinister plot comes into focus, the team must overcome their conflicting personal agendas to unite and save a city of millions.

show.name: Platonic
show.summary: Platonic is a 10-episode, half-hour comedy which explores the inner workings of platonic friendship. A pair of former best friends who met in their youth reconnect as adults and try to mend the rift that led to their falling out. As their friendship becomes more consuming, it destabilizes their lives and causes them to reevaluate their choices.

show.name: Dimension 20
show.summary: Heed the call of adventure and enter Dimension 20 where Game Master Brennan Lee Mulligan, joined by comedians and pro gamers, blends comedy with tabletop RPGs.

show.name: Captivated, by You
show.summary: Explore stories about what it's like to be young at an all-boys school and co-ed high school.

show.name: The Summer I Turned Pretty
show.summary: Belly Conklin is about to turn 16, and she's headed to her favorite place in the world, Cousins Beach, to spend the summer with her family and the Fishers. Belly's grown up a lot over the past year, and she has a feeling that this summer is going to be different than all the summers before.

name: Episode 9298
summary: Andrew tries to retreat from disaster. Paul comes clean. Krista strives under pressure.

show.name: Neighbours
show.summary: The continuation of the long-running daily drama series—about the lives, loves, and challenges of the residents on Ramsay Street in Erinsborough, Australia, a fictional suburb of Melbourne.

show.name: The Rising of the Shield Hero
The Rising of the Shield Hero
show.summary: Iwatani Naofumi, a run-of-the-mill otaku, finds a book in the library that summons him to another world. He is tasked with joining the sword, spear, and bow as one of the Four Cardinal Heroes and fighting the Waves of Catastrophe as the Shield Hero. Excited by the prospect of a grand adventure, Naofumi sets off with his party. However, merely a few days later, he is betrayed and loses all his money, dignity, and respect. Unable to trust anyone anymore, he employs a slave named Raphtalia and takes on the Waves and the world. But will he really find a way to overturn this desperate situation?

show.name: Pssica
show.summary: Three lives intertwine in an unexpected way in the rivers of the Atlantic Amazon: Janalice, a young woman kidnapped by human trafficking; Preá, who needs to come to terms with his destiny as the leader of a gang that operates on the region's rivers; and Mariangel, who seeks revenge for the death of her family. The three will try to survive the "psychic", a curse that they believe has been cast upon them.

show.name: Talk Ville
show.summary: It was only a matter of time - Join costars Tom Welling (Clark Kent) and Michael Rosenbaum (Lex Luthor) as they dissect a new episode every week from one of the greatest shows of all time, Smallville.

show.name: World Wonder Ring STARDOM
show.summary: World Wonder Ring Stardom, legal name Kabushiki Gaisha Stardom (株式会社スターダム Kabushiki Gaisha Sutādamu) and often referred to simply as Stardom (stylized as STARD✪M),[2] is a Japanese joshi puroresu or women's professional wrestling promotion, founded in September 2010 by former Hyper Visual Fighting Arsion and JDStar promoter Rossy Ogawa, retired wrestler, model and mixed martial artist Fuka Kakimoto and veteran professional wrestler Nanae Takahashi. Stardom quickly became one of the top joshi puroresu promotions, largely thanks to gravure idol Yuzuki Aikawa becoming the promotion's public face.

show.name: Acapulco
show.summary: In Acapulco, a young Mexican man's dream comes true when he gets the job of a lifetime at the hottest resort in Acapulco. But he soon realizes the job is far more complicated than he ever imagined as all of his beliefs and morals start to be questioned. The show takes place in 1984 with Eugenio Derbez narrating and playing the present-day version of the main character.

show.name: 10's Late News
show.summary:
Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

show.name: Amanpour
show.summary: Amanpour is CNN International's flagship global affairs interview program hosted by Chief International Correspondent Christiane Amanpour.

show.name: Isa Soares Tonight
show.summary: Drawing on Soares's experience in the field, Isa Soares Tonight will cover the most pressing global issues across politics, business and culture. The nightly program will bring together CNN's world-class journalists with top newsmakers and experts to help viewers navigate the complex events shaping our present and our future.

show.name: One World with Zain Asher and Bianna Golodryga
One World with Zain Asher and Bianna Golodryga
show.summary: Offering a fresh and inclusive take on the top stories from Africa, Europe and beyond, giving every continent an equal voice.

show.name: Connect the World
show.summary: Live from Abu Dhabi with Becky Anderson, this is CNN International's flagship Middle East two hour news program.

show.name: What We Know with Max Foster
What We Know with Max Foster
show.summary: Drawing on Foster's decades of experience covering major world events both on scene and in the studio, What We Know will provide a definitive roundup of the day's top stories, and a deeper dive into the questions sparking debate around the world.

show.name: The Brief with Jim Sciutto
show.summary: The best of CNN's reporting from correspondents across the world, to guide global audiences through the fast-paced news cycle with insight, analysis and hard-hitting interviews.

show.name: Ling Tian Du Zun
show.summary: Ling Tian, a sword saint of his generation, went against the will of heaven to seize the stele in order to save his beloved, but was plotted against by the way of heaven. When he fell, he perished together with the way of heaven, but was unexpectedly reborn, returning to the moment of his death three hundred years ago when his dantian was completely destroyed and his sword bone was taken away. His beauty is still there, his old enemy is still there, and he has been on the long road to becoming a saint, so why not start over? In this life, he vows to rewrite his destiny and make up for his regrets!

show.name: 9News Late
show.summary: Join Nine's national Late News to catch up on the events of the day.

show.name: 5 News at Lunchtime
show.summary: The latest national and international news, sport and weather.

show.name: My Girlfriend Is a Real Man
My Girlfriend Is a Real Man
show.summary: Yunjae Park thought his relationship with his girlfriend, Ji-eun, was perfect--until one shocking morning changed everything. Ji-eun has mysteriously transformed into a man overnight! Can the two adjust to this sudden and earth-shattering change? And will Ji-eun ever turn back to who she once was?!

show.name: Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon
Reborn as a Vending Machine, I Now Wander the Dungeon
show.summary: Following a fatal road accident, our protagonist suddenly finds himself transported to another world, and wakes up with the inability to move, near a mysterious lake. Very quickly, the observation is alarming: our man no longer hears his own voice and worse still: when he tries to scream in fear, the words that come out of his mouth are not the ones he wanted to say. "One product purchased, the second is free! In reality, our hero has turned into a vending machine, and the only actions he is able to perform are limited to those of a simple machine. In such a context, how will he manage to survive in this fantasy world?!

show.name: Varney & Company
show.summary: Varney & Company is hosted by veteran business journalist Stuart Varney, noted for his distinctive British accent, hosts this weekday morning program on which he and his guests discuss the implications of political news on the business world, and also how the news of the day affects personal finances. The company Varney keeps includes regular contributors Charles Payne, Sandra Smith and Elizabeth MacDonald, who weigh in on such issues as government spending, health care and bailouts.

show.name: 100 Huntley Street
show.summary: 100 Huntley Street is Canada's longest running daily television show and the sixth longest running daily television show in the world. Authentic and interactive, 100 Huntley Street brings you the amazing stories of people – whether they be world, leaders, celebrities, sports figures, or everyday people – who have had life-changing encounters with God.

show.name: ABC Late News
show.summary: More news, more often. Wherever you are stay in touch with ABC News. We've got more reporters in more places, connecting communities and covering the stories and issues that matter to you. Presented by Jade Barker.

show.name: America's Newsroom
show.summary: Watch 'America's Newsroom' on Fox News Channel - follow Bill Hemmer and Dana Perino Weekdays 9 a.m. - 11 a.m. ET as they bring you the news that matters to you.

show.name: National Report
show.summary: National Report with Shaun Kraisman and Emma Rechenberg for live breaking news from NY and Washington, on politics, health, finance, and lifestyle that impact you.

show.name: Whale Store xoxo
show.summary:
Wan suddenly loses her job, and to make things worse, her father dies of a heart attack. This forces her to take care of an old grocery store. There, she meets Maewnam, along with a cup of instant noodles labeled with a note: "For a customer at 11 PM." Who would come to buy food at a grocery store at this hour?

That customer turns out to be Maewnam and yes, that is because Wan was Maewnam's love at first sight in the past. She starts hitting on Wan again, head over heels in love. The story reaches her friends, Prof. Chompoo and Prof. Tonnam. Whenever Maewnam consults them about Wan, their opinions always go in opposite directions. What should Maewnam do to win Wan's heart?

previousepisode.name: If opportunity doesn't knock, build a door.

show.name: Vale Tudo
show.summary: Raquel, a hard-working woman who works as a tour guide in Foz do Iguaçu, Paraná. She believes that it is possible to succeed in life with dignity. On the other hand, her daughter, Maria de Fátima, a young woman uninterested in the routine of the quiet city of Paraná, dreams of becoming a digital influencer and getting rich at any cost.

show.name: Ana Cabrera Reports
show.summary: The latest breaking news, reporting and coverage of the day's important stories.

show.name: The Situation Room
show.summary: The Situation Room with Wolf Blitzer and Pamela Brown: The command center for breaking news, politics and extraordinary reports from around the world.

show.name: Hell Teacher: Jigoku Sensei Nube
show.summary: Meisuke Nueno, aka "Nube," a psychic teacher with a demon hand, as he battles evil spirits and monsters to protect his students from supernatural threats.

show.name: Sher
show.summary: Sher is a gripping Pakistani drama packed with raw emotions, intense rivalries, and deep-rooted traditions. From kidnappings and secret alliances to broken promises and forbidden love, every episode leaves you wanting more.

show.name: The Faulkner Focus
show.summary: Emmy-winning journalist Harris Faulkner provides the latest news driving the day with insightful analysis and interviews with top newsmakers.

show.name: Inside Monster Jam
show.summary: This official Monster Jam podcast offers exclusive inside access to Monster Jam Operations, including drivers, safety, track design and the Monster Jam Garage.

show.name: Dealing With Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze
Dealing With Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze
show.summary: Yu Ayase's mother Subaru is gifted with beauty, athleticism, and intelligence, but Yu seems to have only inherited his mother's good looks and nothing else. When Yu is enrolled into a high-class school, he is entrusted to the care of his mother's friend, and moves to their house. There, he begins rooming with the three Mikadono sisters, who are all exceptionally talented in their own way, but have a weak side to them.

show.name: Onmyo Kaiten Re:Birth Verse
show.summary: Narihira Takeru is a delinquent who often thinks about Tsukimiya, the girl who appears in his dreams. After an unexpected accident, Takeru finds himself in a parallel universe, and the world that Tsukimiya lives in. When Takeru and Tsukimiya are slain by a monster, he awakens again and realizes he has leapt through time. Now, Takeru must train with Abe Seimei to fight for Tsukimiya's life!

previousepisode.name: This Time I'll Protect You! What Appeared beyond the Centennial Pandemonium

show.name: The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox
The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox
show.summary: A limited series inspired by the story of how Amanda Knox was wrongfully convicted for the tragic murder of her roommate, Meredith Kercher, and her 16-year odyssey to set herself free.

show.name: The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox
The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox
show.summary: A limited series inspired by the story of how Amanda Knox was wrongfully convicted for the tragic murder of her roommate, Meredith Kercher, and her 16-year odyssey to set herself free.

show.name: Days of Our Lives
show.summary:
Days of our Lives is set in the fictitious Midwestern town of Salem. The core families are the Bradys, the Hortons and the DiMeras, and the multi-layered storylines involve elements of romance, adventure, mystery, comedy and drama.

Beginning on September 12, 2022, DAYS became exclusive to streaming on Peacock.

show.name: Chris Jansing Reports
show.summary: The latest breaking news, reporting and coverage of the day's important stories.

show.name: The Big Money Show
show.summary: Taylor Riggs, Brian Brenberg and Jackie DeAngelis host an informative and fast-paced hour filled with business topics that impact everyone from Wall Street to the average person.

show.name: 5 News at 5
show.summary: National and international news.

show.name: Access Daily with Mario & Kit
show.summary: The latest celebrity gossip, opinions, Hollywood happenings, and the day's big news.

show.name: Inside Politics
show.summary: Dana Bash features the top political stories, sourced by the best reporters.

show.name: Outnumbered
show.summary: Featuring an ensemble of four female panelists and one rotating male, Outnumbered examines the top news stories as well as the leading pop culture and relationship issues dominating the headlines. FNC's Harris Faulkner, Kayleigh McEnany and Emily Compagno lead the program's coverage, while alternating co-panelists weigh in with analysis.

show.name: Newsline
show.summary: Bianca de la Garza tackles the big news from D.C., N.Y., across America, and around the world!

show.name: I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
I Was Reincarnated as the 7th Prince so I Can Take My Time Perfecting My Magical Ability
show.summary: Prince Lloyd wasn't always a prince...in fact, his previous life is one he remembers perfectly: he was a sorcerer, of sorts. So when he was forced to reincarnate, he decided to continue his studies, prince of the realm or no! But his new life has its own sets of challenges...including being a 10-year-old! What's the 7th prince/sorcerer to do?!

show.name: The Young and the Restless
show.summary: The Young and the Restless revolves around the rivalries, romances, hopes and fears of the residents of the fictional Midwestern metropolis, Genoa City. The lives and loves of a wide variety of characters mingle through the generations, dominated by the Newman, Abbott, Chancellor, Baldwin and Winters families. ­ When The Young and the Restless premiered in 1973, it revolutionized the daytime drama. It continues to set the standard with strong characters, socially conscious storylines, romance and sensuality.

show.name: ABC News Live
show.summary: ABC News Live will bring streaming viewers the latest headlines, compelling stories, interviews and roundtable discussions.

show.name: Aftenshowet
show.summary: DR1's journalistic talk show directly from the City Hall Square in Copenhagen.

show.name: America Reports
show.summary: A look at the latest news and headlines with Sandra Smith and John Roberts

show.name: CNN News Central (PM)
show.summary: News from around the world with Brianna Keilar and Boris Sanchez.

show.name: Alles was zählt
show.summary: Alles was zählt is a German television soap opera. The original plot revolved around Diana Sommer's dream to become a world class ice skater. She fell in love with Julian Herzog, who signed her at the prestigious Steinkamp Sport and Wellness Center, run by the unscrupulous Steinkamp dynasty. The story continues to revolve around the Steinkamp Sport and Wellness Centre and its quest to become a sporting powerhouse, as well as the lives of the characters who work at and around the Centre.

show.name: New Saga
show.summary: After a brutal war, magic swordsman Kyle defeats the Demon King but is left dying. A crimson crystal sends him four years into the past to his once-destroyed hometown where he finds his lost loved ones alive. Armed with future knowledge, Kyle vows to prevent the coming tragedy and rewrite fate.

show.name: 5 News at 18.55
show.summary: National and international news.

show.name: American Agenda
show.summary: American Agenda with hosts Bob Brooks & Katrina Szish is a live, fast-paced look at national news and international events. The program brings viewers the latest from Washington, with insightful analysis from lawmakers and experts, and media reports from New York and around the globe.

show.name: Katy Tur Reports
show.summary: The latest breaking news, reporting and live coverage of the day's important stories; hosted by trusted NBC News journalists, these dynamic hours offer discussions with newsmakers, journalists and politicians.

show.name: Beyond the Gates
show.summary: Beyond the Gates is set in a leafy Maryland suburb just outside of Washington D.C., and in one the most affluent African American counties in the United States. Here you'll find a posh gated community with winding tree-lined streets and luxurious mansions to call home. At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. But behind these pristine walls and lush, manicured gardens are juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered. And those that live outside these gates are watching closely. These are the places where our characters live, love, work and play. Those who have "made it" and those who haven't are all trying to navigate life … and some with more grace than others.

show.name: Making Money with Charles Payne
show.summary: Long-time Wall Street broker and analyst Charles Payne hosts his own daily program Making Money with Charles Payne that helps viewers spot emerging investment prospects. A panel of business and market specialists joins him to discuss the latest headlines, wrap up the day's activities in the markets, and focus on tomorrow's moneymakers. Payne says, "There are money-making opportunities behind every headline." His goal is to help viewers "find their confidence in the markets and realize their long-term dreams and goals."

show.name: General Hospital
show.summary: General Hospital, which celebrated its golden anniversary on April 1, 2013, continues its tradition of passion, intrigue and adventure that takes place in the fictional town of Port Charles in upstate New York. The glamour and excitement of those who have come to find their destinies in this familiar seaport town intertwine with the lives, loves and fortunes of beloved, well-known faces. As always, love, danger and mind blowing plot twists continue to abound on General Hospital with contemporary storylines and unforgettable characters.

show.name: 5 News at 19:55
show.summary: National and international news

show.name: The Claman Countdown
show.summary: The close of the trading day is covered.

show.name: The Story
show.summary: The Story with Martha MacCallum, anchored by Martha MacCallum, focuses on the stories that are most important to Americans with insight from top newsmakers and analysts.

show.name: The Fortune Hotel
show.summary: You can't trust anyone at The Fortune Hotel. Stephen Mangan invites us to a luxury Caribbean resort filled with glamour, opulence and deception as ten pairs compete for £250K.

show.name: Deadline: White House
show.summary: Hosted by Nicolle Wallace, this program provides in-depth reporting and dynamic discussions on the political stories driving the news cycle. Nicolle Wallace brings viewers the latest political developments of the day, in addition to interviews with leading newsmakers and influential politicians. Drawing on her years of experience as communications chief for President George W. Bush and senior advisor for the McCain-Palin campaign, Wallace provides political insight and clarity on where key decision-makers stand on complex issues.

show.name: Kudlow
show.summary: Host Larry Kudlow leads roundtable discussions on the policies impacting the domestic and global economies and interviews with business influencers across the world.

show.name: ABC News Breakfast
show.summary: Be the first to know what's happened overnight. Michael Rowland and Lisa Millar, Paul Kennedy, Georgie Tunny and Nate Byrne bring you breaking news, interviews and all the information you need to get you through the day.

show.name: Al Rojo Vivo
show.summary: Al Rojo Vivo is a news magazine that in one hour, takes viewers on a journey through the world. It is an "information paella" that offers something for everyone: local and international news, entertainment, fashion, live interviews, special investigations, human interest, health, consumer alerts and new technology.

show.name: The Arena with Kasie Hunt
show.summary: Kasie Hunt brings key players into the arena for sharp analysis and panel discussion on the latest news in politics and culture.

name: Episode 7
summary:
The X-bus has only just left one destination behind and is already in trouble with the law... or is it? Rob Brydon has plenty more tricks up his sleeve as the players head into a new country on their way towards the next Destination X. Tensions mount as the passengers are given the opportunity to scupper each other in a challenge that will test their memory and their reflexes, as well as their loyalty to each other.

As well as learning who they can trust, the players also need to be sure they can believe their own eyes, as a view from the X-bus windows seems to give the game away, but could this be another devious deception?

show.name: Destination X
show.summary:
Merging fantasy with reality in this larger-than-life adventure competition series, viewers will follow contestants as they embark on the road trip of a lifetime but have no idea of their location. In order to win, they must figure out their mystery locations. Once they're on the blacked-out Destination X bus, the journey transforms into a real-life board game, with challenges designed to offer clever clues as to their location, along with a few misdirects to keep them guessing.

At the end of each episode, the contestant who places an X on a map furthest from the actual location packs their bags. The first participant to reach Destination X will be crowned the winner. With high stakes and mind-blowing, spectacular gameplay, the series will keep viewers engaged and playing along on all screens.

show.name: The Will Cain Show
show.summary: Featuring conversations with newsmakers from across politics, business, culture and sports, The Will Cain Show will offer a comprehensive look at the news of the day in a signature podcast style.

show.name: The Chris Salcedo Show
show.summary: "The Chris Salcedo Show" features your conservative, liberty-loving host, who confronts the biased press, both political parties, and the extremist left — every day.

name: Episode 7
summary: The Chase's Mark Labbett heads out on his first date with a fellow quizzer, and 1990s pop stars Kerry Katona and Jon Lee go on a double date.

show.name: Celebs Go Dating
show.summary: Single celebrities join an exclusive dating agency in a bid to find true love. Matchmakers pair them with non-celebrity partners and the cameras capture every romantic and cringe-filled moment.

show.name: The Evening Edit
show.summary: Host Elizabeth MacDonald interviews industry experts to get the inside scoop on the day's leading headlines as they relate to your wallet.

show.name: The Lead with Jake Tapper
show.summary: CNN's chief Washington correspondent, Jake Tapper, hosts this hourlong weekday afternoon program, which mixes Tapper's interests with headlines from around the country and the world, headlines that span politics, money, sports and popular culture. The Lead with Jake Tapper also concentrates on bringing stories that aren't found on front pages -- buried leads -- to the forefront. Tapper came to CNN from ABC News, where he most recently served as senior White House correspondent.

show.name: The Five
show.summary: The Five is an American news and talk show on Fox News Channel featuring a rotating panel who discuss current stories, political issues, and pop culture. The show premiered in July 2011, replacing the Glenn Beck program, and airs on weekdays at 5:00 p.m. ET with replays at 4:00 a.m. ET. On October 3, 2011, after successful ratings and high popularity, Fox News announced that The Five would become the permanent 5 p.m. series, as the program had previously been announced to last only during the summer. The Five is currently the second-most-watched program in all of cable news in the United States, placing only behind The O'Reilly Factor, also on the Fox News Channel. The program has occasionally been the number one rated cable news series in the key 25 to 54 viewing demographic.

show.name: Carl Higbie Frontline
show.summary: Carl Higbie Frontline focuses on providing commonsense news analysis, exposing big government overreach and the media's shortfalls — all while always fighting for American values. Produced from Newsmax's Manhattan studios covering breaking news and exploring key issues such as personal liberty, security, and government transparency.

show.name: The Beat with Ari Melber
show.summary: The Beat with Ari Melber delivers the biggest political and news stories of the day, with interviews and original reporting from around the nation. An Emmy-winning journalist, attorney and former Senate staffer, Melber cuts through the spin and the noise to tell you what's really happening. Real news, every night.

show.name: The Bottom Line
show.summary: Dagen McDowell and Sean Duffy take on the hotly debated issues in the business and political world, plus the kitchen table topics that matter most to Americans.

show.name: Special Report
show.summary: Special Report with Bret Baier (formerly Special Report with Brit Hume) is an American television news and political commentary program appearing on Fox News Channel, currently hosted by Bret Baier. It airs live each Monday through Friday at 6:00 PM ET. The show focuses on both reporting and analysis of the day's events, with a primary focus on national political news. The show has been a part of the Fox News program lineup since 1998 and is the number one cable news broadcast in its time slot.

show.name: Helt sort
show.summary: Melvin travels around Denmark learns the culture and sees the attractions in the different places.

show.name: The Record with Greta Van Susteren
The Record with Greta Van Susteren
show.summary: Award-winning journalist Greta Van Susteren digs into the top stories of the day with the focus on why they matter to the American people. Greta speaks with the top newsmakers on both sides of the aisle, creating a conversation and dialogue that is imperative for the nation's well-being.

show.name: The Weeknight
show.summary: One-on-one conversations with politicians and newsmakers, and the breaking issues of the day.

show.name: ABC News Mornings
show.summary: When big stories break, turn to ABC News in the mornings to bring you what's happening and why it matters. We have more reporters in more places, serving and connecting communities and telling your stories. Presented by Gemma Veness (Mon-Wed) and Dan Bourchier (Thu-Fri).

show.name: Erin Burnett OutFront
show.summary: Erin Burnett OutFront is an hour-long television news program hosted by Erin Burnett on CNN. The show premiered on October 3, 2011 in the 7PM and 11PM time slot to replace John King, USA. CNN said in 2011 they hoped Burnett's expected popularity would provide an "attractive" opening to an evening of "talk shows and news analysis". Erin Burnett, OutFront is broadcast live from CNN's Time Warner Center studios in New York City or on location from the site of a breaking news event, airing from 7:00 pm ET to 8:00 pm ET and also airs via tape-delay on CNN Philippines every Tuesday-Friday at 5:00 pm local time since March 17, 2015. The program covers a number of news stories of the day in a Count-up format, starting at #1 – most important and making it to #7 by the end of the hour. Burnett's program features taped packages from CNN Correspondents along with analysis and panel discussion.

show.name: The Ingraham Angle
show.summary: The Ingraham Angle cuts through the Washington chatter to speak directly with unexpected voices and the actual people who are impacted by the news of the day.

show.name: Rob Schmitt Tonight
show.summary: Rob Schmitt Tonight locks in all the late-breaking stories that matter to you, and delivers the up-to-the-minute news you need to hear before turning in.

show.name: All Elite Wrestling: Dynamite
show.summary: WarnerMedia announced today that it is partnering with All Elite Wrestling (AEW), the new professional wrestling promotion featuring a world-class roster of diverse male and female wrestlers, giving fans a new wrestling experience for the first time in 20 years. WarnerMedia and AEW together will build this powerhouse sporting league from the ground up and will begin airing weekly matches later this year. With this league, AEW is introducing a new generation of wrestlers to fans, offering fun, gripping and authentic athletic matches that will make wrestling more accessible to a broad audience.

show.name: Открытый брак
show.summary: A married couple well over 40, married for 20 years, three children. Faced with the crisis of such a long, albeit happy relationship, they come to an agreement - to live in the format of an open marriage. Now they meet with other people, trying to figure out whether it is possible to become happy and not lose a loved one.

show.name: Хутор
show.summary: Artyom, an information gypsy, is trying to escape justice and is hiding from persecution in a "farm." The closed community is led by a Father who has renounced technology and other benefits of civilization. Numerous followers of the leader live by his laws, but with the advent of Artyom, the usual order of things begins to change. Sergey Romanovich's first project after returning to the industry.

show.name: Хутор

show.name: Hannity
show.summary:
Hannity & Colmes was a live television show on Fox News Channel in the United States, hosted by Sean Hannity and Alan Colmes, who respectively presented a conservative and liberal perspective. The series premiered on October 7, 1996, and the final episode aired on January 9, 2009. It was the precursor to the Hannity program, which airs in the same time slot. The show offered Hannity's conservative views and Colmes's liberal views incorporated into a current news story, or in conjunction with a featured guest.

In addition to politics, the show featured debate about soft news stories, such as the 2006 Duke University lacrosse team scandal or the death of Anna Nicole Smith, or one-on-one interviews with politicians, commonly with the host who most closely shared the guest's political ideology. The show's format resembled a former CNN show called Crossfire, which similarly had co-hosts on both the left and right.

Fox announced on November 24, 2008 that Alan Colmes would leave the show at the end of the year, but he remains a commentator on Fox News, runs the blog Liberaland, and makes occasional appearances on other programs like The O'Reilly Factor, and Shovio.com's TalkBackTV. On December 11, it was announced that Hannity would take over the time slot alone with a new show simply titled Hannity, which would have a format closer to his weekend program Hannity's America. January 9, 2009 was the last airing of Hannity & Colmes, with January 12 marking the beginning of the new Hannity program.

The show follows the team as they scour the country for hidden gems in junkyards, basements, garages and barns, meeting quirky characters and hearing their amazing stories. If you think the antique business is all about upscale boutiques and buttoned-up dealers, this show may change your mind – and teach you a thing or two about American history along the way.

Over a decade ago, the once-powerful Wuji Sword God was severely injured by the schemes of the Changsheng Sword God, forcing him to retreat into seclusion in the mountains, detached from worldly affairs. 

Now, Zhan Yibai, Wuji Sword God's only disciple, has finally come of age, and the time has arrived for him to embark on a journey of training as agreed upon by master and disciple. Before departing, to enhance Zhan Yibai's self-defense abilities, Wuji Sword God gifted him his personal sword and instructed him to rapidly achieve the realm of Sword God. New to the secular world, Zhan Yibai befriends Jiang Mingyue, Princess of the dynasty, and Li Kuang, the second son of the Prince of Zhennan. Hoping to rapidly grow, he and his companions participate in the "Ancient Dynasty Ruins" trial, embarking on a remarkable journey.

show.name: Threads of Destiny
show.summary: Both of the Jiang family's daughters are reborn. Jiang Xueying, the eldest daughter of the Jiang family, swaps her marriage with her younger sister Jiang Yu'er. As the prince's wife, Jiang Xueying battles cunning rivals in the household, including Jiang Yu'er. She reforms her reckless husband and joins forces with him to expose a sinister conspiracy.

show.name: The Crime Unit of Tang Dynasty
The Crime Unit of Tang Dynasty
ABC News Afternoons
show.summary: Australia's most trusted source of independent news, ABC News connects all Australians with the latest news, investigative reporting, reliable information and expert analysis to help you stay informed and up-to-date.

summary: There's drama at the stag and hen nights, Harry is given a difficult job, and Walford's teens get their GCSE results.

show.name: EastEnders
show.summary:
Set in the East End of London, the show focuses on the tensions between love and family with stories ranging from hard-hitting social issues, to personal, human tragedies. And there's plenty of funny moments too. 

Classic characters old and new across thousands of episodes have shared a drink in The Queen Vic, shed tears of despair or joy, sat on Arthur's bench in the Square... and at some point or other they probably crossed paths with Ian Beale.

show.name: 10 News First: Afternoon
show.summary: The 30-minute bulletin will feature comprehensive coverage of local, national and international news, breaking stories, and all the latest in sport and weather, offering viewers an informative update on the day's biggest headlines each weekday afternoon.

show.name: 1 News at Six
show.summary: Join the 1 NEWS team as they bring you the latest news from here and overseas.

show.name: 10 NEWS+
show.summary:
10 NEWS+ will follow Network 10's 5pm local news bulletins across the country, offering viewers extended context and deeper reporting on the day's biggest stories. The 5pm bulletin remains a cornerstone of the network's trusted news offering, delivering the latest breaking news and updates.

10 NEWS+ aims to redefine evening news by providing comprehensive analysis, trusted reporting, and long-form investigative journalism. The program will offer a fresh perspective on critical local and global stories, tailored for an engaged audience seeking in-depth news coverage.

At a time when misinformation is rife, 10 NEWS+ is steadfast in its commitment to truth and transparency, delivering journalism with integrity, clarity, and purpose.

Designed for Australia's evolving media landscape, 10 NEWS+ will integrate across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms, ensuring content is accessible and engaging for Australians everywhere.

The program will be anchored Sunday to Thursday by investigative journalist Denham Hitchcock and Walkley Award-winning journalist Amelia Brace, with Senior Journalist and respected news anchor Ursula Heger and National Affairs Editor Hugh Riminton leading coverage every Friday.

show.name: Can Bagi
show.summary:
Mahinur Kılıçtan, a hard-working mother, lives in a cordial, traditional neighbourhood with her daughter, Bade and her deceitful husband, Kenan. For some time now, Bade has been frequently falling ill, forcing Mahinur to leave her job as a cleaner at one of the Yılmazer Holding hospitals. Now, she bears the entire responsibility of providing for her family by taking on temporary cleaning jobs.

Aras Yılmazer, Mahinur's former employer, lives in a family mansion that has been passed down through generations, sharing the grand residence with his daughter Derin, his mother Selvihan, his aunt Leyla, and his cousin Ejder. Aras's wife, Banu, tragically passed away due to certain complications during their daughter's birth. After her death, although Aras refrained from pursuing a new relationship for some time, he eventually became engaged to Pelin—a woman from a similarly prominent family and now a management executive at the hospital—to provide Derin with a stable family life.

When fate reveals the heart-wrenching truth that Mahinur and Aras's daughters, Bade and Derin, were switched at birth, a devoted mother and a businessman find their worlds colliding in unimaginable ways. Bound by the desperate need to save the life of Bade, who was diagnosed with hemolytic anaemia, they enter into a marriage of convenience to bring a sibling into the world, who can become a stem cell donor. Yet, as they navigate the delicate threads of secrets, sacrifices, and a carefully crafted facade, an unexpected love begins to blossom—turning their unlikely union into a tale of redemption, healing, and the power of the heartstrings.

show.name: Way Too Early
show.summary: The fast-paced program brings viewers everything they need to know to start their days--from news and politics to sports and pop culture.

show.name: FOX Weather First
show.summary: Waking up at 5 am to the first live national forecast of the day; all the latest weather news and everything one needs to prepare for the day ahead.

show.name: A Current Affair
show.summary: A Current Affair covers the realms of politics, crime, human rights, science, technology, celebrities and entertainment - all investigated by a dedicated team.

show.name: Early Start with Rahel Solomon
show.summary: The news you need, first thing. Rahel Solomon has you covered with the latest headlines.

show.name: Deal or No Deal
show.summary:
Deal or No Deal, the exhilarating hit game show where contestants must beat the Banker to win a huge cash prize of $100,000, is making a triumphant return to 10 and 10 Play.

Hosted by TV Week Gold Logie award winner Grant Denyer, every episode is a high-pressure, high-stakes game of risk versus reward in which contestants face a series of potentially life-altering decisions.

show.name: FOX & Friends First
show.summary: Kicking off the day, FOX & Friends First delivers all the headlines viewers may have missed overnight, along with a preview of upcoming news events. Presented two hours before FOX & Friends, the first hour of the program is hosted by Todd Piro and Carley Shimkus

show.name: Home and Away
show.summary: Home and Away follows the lives and loves of the residents in Summer Bay, a fictional seaside town of New South Wales. The series initially focuses on the Fletcher family – Tom, Pippa and their five foster children, Frank Morgan, Carly Morris, Lynn Davenport, Steven Matheson and Sally Fletcher – who relocated from the city and moved into the Summer Bay House, where they took on the new job of running the caravan park, and eventually took in a sixth foster child, Bobby Simpson.

show.name: Live: NRL Thursday Night Footy
show.summary: Live football action on channel 9.

name: Adelaide to Kangaroo Island
summary: Steph and Claudia embark on a vibrant road trip from Adelaide to Kangaroo Island, uncovering the heart and soul of South Australia through its people, and stories.

show.name: Great Australian Road Trips
show.summary: From the dirt tracks of the Red Centre Way in the Northern Territory to the Great Barrier Reef Drive in northern Queensland, Kangaroo Island in South Australia to the waterfalls and windswept beauty of Tasmania's western coast, iconic Grand Pacific Drive south of Sydney to the nerve-jangling drive across the East Alligator River, this is the ultimate open road enthusiast's guide to Australia.

show.name: Wanmei Shijie
show.summary: Born into a unique world where villages fight to gain power and control, the main character, Shi Hao, is a genius blessed by the heavens born under the poorest conditions. His clan, however, has a mysterious past. To rise and become the genius he is meant to be, the clan goes through every effort to aid his cultivation as they battle through fanatical monsters and engage in power struggles with other clans. His journey will bring him through unknown lands until he can become a person that can truly shake the world.

name: Forrest, VIC
summary: Guest presenter Paul West ditches his car for a bicycle when he arrives in Forrest nestled in Victoria's Otway Ranges. It's here Paul discovers a former logging town that's now more famous for mountain biking than sawmills.

show.name: Back Roads
show.summary: Back Roads transports audiences to some of the nation's most remote and inspiring communities that highlight rural Australia's trademark grit, generosity, humour and innovation. Each week award-winning ABC journalist, Heather Ewart, who grew up on a sheep and wheat farm in Victoria, uncovers corners of Australia where misfortune has brought some to their knees, but imagination, faith and fun has lifted them back up.

show.name: Morning Joe
show.summary: On Morning Joe, the hosts Joe Scarborough, Mika Brzezinski, and Willie Geist engage in dynamic discussion about political news and issues important to all Americans. Morning Joe attracts a variety of guests, including top newsmakers, politicians and cultural influencers.

show.name: Mornings with Maria
show.summary: Veteran business journalist Maria Bartiromo brings her knowledge of the financial industry to this early show that features a roundtable of rotating industry experts alongside the host. Bartiromo and her guests discuss news stories -- domestic and international -- and other topics that are expected to impact the economy and markets that day. The show's intent is to give viewers a jump-start on making moves to get the most out of their investments.

show.name: CNN This Morning
show.summary: Start your day with Audie Cornish bringing you the latest headlines and analysis.

show.name: FOX & Friends
show.summary: FOX & Friends is a conservative American early-morning news and opinion talk show on the Fox News Channel. It begins at 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time with the latest Fox News Live headlines and news of the morning and continues with a variety of segments including current events, interviews, updates of news stories with correspondents, right-leaning analysis from the hosts, and entertainment segments.

show.name: Wake Up America Early
show.summary: Wake up to reliable reporting that delivers the essential facts you need to start your day informed, along with expert commentary and thoughtful analysis. Get an early look at the top stories shaping national and global conversations. Whether it's politics, business, culture, or breaking news, you'll be prepared for whatever the day brings.

show.name: CNN News Central
show.summary: Anchored by John Berman, Kate Bolduan and Sara Sidner, CNN News Central is the core hub of the network's best-in-class newsgathering operation during the day, bringing stories to viewers in real time, while offering perspective and context to key issues. Modeled after CNN's special election programming, CNN News Central uses similar technology and storytelling tools, and applies them to news well beyond politics. The immersive approach will showcase what CNN does best – breaking news, visual storytelling, and factual, impactful reporting.

show.name: Boys Planet
show.summary: <BOYS PLANET> presents the potential of the boys from all around the world. When the two worlds of K-Group and G-Group collide, ONE WORLD is born. K-Pop Boy Group audition project decided and produced only by Korean and global fans.

show.name: Wake Up America
show.summary: Start your day and weekend with real news and analysis from Rob Finnerty, Michael Grimm & Sarah Williamson and team.

show.name: Catch Your Luck
show.summary: A drama depicting the turbulent and eventful growth period of three friends; one rich, one poor, and one who wants to be rich, and their families.

show.name: WWE Main Event
show.summary: WWE Main Event is a professional wrestling television program produced by WWE that originally aired on Ion Television in the United States and it originally aired on the WWE Network now airing on Hulu.

show.name: Peacemaker
show.summary: The series will explore the origins of the Peacemaker, a man who believes in peace at any cost - no matter how many people he has to kill to get it.

show.name: Back to the Frontier
show.summary: Back to the Frontier transports participants to a meticulously recreated historical setting, challenging them to live and compete as pioneers. Contestants must perform tasks essential to frontier life, such as farming, building shelters and crafting tools, using only period-appropriate methods. They face environmental hardships, limited resources and the necessity of community cooperation. The show examines survival instincts, adaptability and the contrast between modern conveniences and historical realities, offering viewers an immersive historical experience.

show.name: Hostage
show.summary:
Abigail Dalton the recently elected British Prime Minister is fighting for office thanks to a healthcare crisis. Vivienne Toussaint is the first female French President campaigning for re-election no matter what — including tackling France's borders.

A summit between the two women could be the answer to their prayers if they can agree. But when Dalton's husband is kidnapped and Toussaint is blackmailed, they both face unimaginable choices. Forced into a fierce rivalry where their political futures, and lives, might hang in the balance, can they work together to uncover the plot that threatens them both?

show.summary: Brazil enters the most coveted drag queen competition in the world. The queens will have to show lots of charisma, personality, nerve and talent to stay in the competition for the desired title of Brazilian Drag Superstar. Hosted by Grag Queen.

show.name: 10's Late News
show.summary:
Ursula Heger, a senior journalist at 10 News First, will anchor the newly reintroduced news bulletin. Having been with the network since 2011, Heger has covered significant events, including the Ukraine conflict, the demise of Queen Elizabeth II, and other critical global stories.

Channel 10 states the bulletin aims to offer viewers a detailed wrap-up of the day's major stories, delivered in a digital-first format that allows audiences to tune in from any device, at their convenience.

show.summary: Amanpour is CNN International's flagship global affairs interview program hosted by Chief International Correspondent Christiane Amanpour.

show.name: Isa Soares Tonight
show.summary: Drawing on Soares's experience in the field, Isa Soares Tonight will cover the most pressing global issues across politics, business and culture. The nightly program will bring together CNN's world-class journalists with top newsmakers and experts to help viewers navigate the complex events shaping our present and our future.

One World with Zain Asher and Bianna Golodryga
show.summary: Offering a fresh and inclusive take on the top stories from Africa, Europe and beyond, giving every continent an equal voice.

What We Know with Max Foster
show.summary: Drawing on Foster's decades of experience covering major world events both on scene and in the studio, What We Know will provide a definitive roundup of the day's top stories, and a deeper dive into the questions sparking debate around the world.

show.name: The Brief with Jim Sciutto
show.summary: The best of CNN's reporting from correspondents across the world, to guide global audiences through the fast-paced news cycle with insight, analysis and hard-hitting interviews.

show.summary: A romantic story between a photographer and a model from an erotic magazine, as they shoot a film that belongs only to the two of them, right in the heart of Kyoto.
